jobs.title: All Programs - Project Coordinator
jobs.description:

Since 1994, Franklin Energy has been a trusted partner in protecting communities and our planet, paving the way for a sustainable future for all. Learn more at www.franklinenergy.com and join us in leading the clean energy revolution.

This position is additionally responsible for managing customer grant processing, informing energy advisors of expiring grants and applications, and assisting customers and clients.

* Review project applications and documentation to ensure completeness and adherence to program rules and requirements. Communicate incentive changes and disqualifications to customers and Trade Allies

Education and Experience
  

* High School diploma or equivalent required
* 1 – 3 years of previous office experience

* Strong customer service and communication skills
* Must be able to handle a wide work variety and work in a fast-paced environment

* Ability to identify and resolve project application issues with customers and trade allies
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, specifically Word, Excel and Outlook

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Young & Healthy**

Through prevention, education, family support, and access to healthcare services, Young & Healthy protects and improves the physical and mental health of uninsured and underinsured children and their families in the greater Pasadena area. The problem with healthcare services in the Pasadena area is not one of availability, but of affordability and accessibility. One of the greatest obstacles to good health is poverty. In the Pasadena community, about one-third of the children are in need of the kind of care Young & Healthy provides. The majority of children under age 18 and enrolled in Pasadena Unified Schools live in areas of town that claim the lowest per capita income and the greatest concentration of poverty.

Young & Healthy’s model is simple: people helping people. Through collaboration with other community institutions, Young & Healthy makes it a point to know the community and be known by the community so that knowledge and resources can be maximized among community partners to assist the greatest number of neighbors in need.

Young & Healthy is now sustained by the generosity of a volunteer workforce of more than 350 healthcare professionals, over 125 community volunteers and an extensive network of community partners to provide free healthcare to needy underserved children. These professional volunteers agree to see children in their own private offices, on a rotating basis, at no charge to the patient or to Young & Healthy. Young & Healthy facilitates the delivery of donated medical, dental, mental health and other healthcare services, free-of-charge, to underserved low-income children, ranging in age from infancy to 18 years, throughout the greater Pasadena area. In addition to healthcare support, Young & Healthy offers these additional services to the community:

**Health Insurance Assistance** – Young & Healthy helps to prepare families to enroll in and navigate the healthcare system by assisting with health insurance enrollment, providing education and instruction, as well as advocating for clients when they have been wrongfully denied.

**Trauma Informed Care** - Young & Healthy is committed to creating a healthy community for children and families by educating children, parents, and educators on how to become more aware of and sensitive to those who have suffered trauma. Through parent education and professional development for teachers, Young & Healthy staff offers a series of trainings on trauma informed care to the public, Pasadena Unified School District staff and administrators, and others.

**Position Overview**

The Program Coordinator is responsible for the insurance enrollment, navigation, and insurance support services of clients referred to Young & Healthy.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

**1. Insurance Services**

a. Provide clients with health insurance information, application, and navigation.

b. Assist clients with accessing, understanding, and utilizing health insurance.

c. Continuously update their knowledge base about community services and discover ways for Young & Healthy and our clients to use those services.

d. Identify and communicate to the Program Director newly identified client needs, gaps in services, successes, and issues with case management.

e. Attend and fully participate in the Care Team and all other office meetings for which their attendance is required.

Participate in community networking activities.

**2. Professional Development**

a. Constantly increases knowledge as it relates to the services Young & Healthy provides to the community

**Qualifications:** The qualifications described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**1.**  **Education/Experience**

a. B.A. or B.S. preferred

b. A minimum of 3 years of employment or volunteer activities with a non-profit agency

**2. Special knowledge, skills, and abilities**

a. Must be bilingual in English and Spanish

b. Ability to fluently read, write, and speak English

c. Ability to be flexible, meet deadlines and work effectively under stress

d. Demonstrated leadership skills

e. Ability to work with diverse populations

f. Strong written and oral communication skills

g. Must be detail oriented

h. Strong and positive interpersonal skills, ability to resolve conflicts

i. Ability to organize work, prioritize multiple tasks, and follow through on own initiative

j. Good organizational skills

k. Experience in non-profit organizations

l. Must be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

m. Experience with FAMCare software or other client-based software

**3. Physical Requirements**

a. Must be able to speak and hear

b. Must be able to lift 20 pounds

c. Must have sufficient stamina to work long hours, sit or stand for long periods, and concentrate for long periods of time

d. Evening and weekend work may be required

Pay: $19.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: 24.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Lead Coach and Program Coordinator - Tennis
jobs.description:
About us

Based in Westchester, Hot Shots Tennis runs afterschool and in-school tennis programs at elementary campuses in Westchester, Playa del Rey, Playa Vista, Marina del Rey, Venice, El Segundo, and Manhattan Beach. Some of our school partnerships go back more than nine years. Our USTA Net Generation-aligned curriculum includes Little Aces (K–2), Future Champs (grades 3–5), and our Level Up skill badge program.

The role

The Lead Coach & Program Coordinator leads classes at our school sites and spends about 6 hours a week on program coordination. The coordination time has flexible hours, can mostly be done remotely, and can be done in the mornings, before classes start at noon. You'll report to the Program Director.

Coaching responsibilities

* Lead afterschool and in-school classes at assigned school sites
* Deliver the Little Aces and Future Champs 10-week curriculum as written
* Run the Level Up badge program: assess skills, track progress, and award levels
* Keep sessions safe, organized, and fun, with a focus on beginners
* Follow each campus's check-in, dismissal, and pickup procedures
* Set up and pack up equipment at every session

Principal relationships and campus reservations stay with the Program Director. Log your coordination hours weekly.

What this role does not handle:

All financial matters are handled by the program's owners. This role has no access to or responsibility for:

* Tuition, payments, refunds, or invoicing
* Pricing, discounts, or contract terms with schools
* Payroll, timesheets beyond your own, or coach pay
* Budgets or purchasing (equipment requests go to the Program Director)
* Scholarships or financial aid

When a parent, school, or coach asks about any of these, reply: "I'll pass that along to our program office, and they'll follow up with you." Then forward the question the same day.

Qualifications

* Experience coaching youth tennis, ideally with elementary-age beginners
* Familiarity with USTA Net Generation (or willingness to get certified)
* Clear, friendly, and reliable written communication with parents and school staff
* Organized and comfortable with email, shared docs, and spreadsheets
* Reliable transportation between Westside and South Bay school sites
* Ability to transport gear for the classes in your vehicle if needed
* Able to pass a background check and meet school-site clearance requirements

Schedule, pay & how to apply

* **Schedule:** 15–17 coaching hours/week, scheduled between 12–4 pm on weekdays and 9–11:30 am on Saturdays, plus about 6 flexible coordination hours/week (about 21–23 hours/week total)
* **Pay:** $40–65/hr on court, depending on experience; $25/hr for coordination work; $80/hr for private lessons
* **Start date:** Mid-November 2026
* **To apply:** send a resume and a short note about your coaching experience to hotshotstennisorg1@gmail.com

Pay: $35.00 - $65.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Opportunities for advancement

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Accounts Payable/Receivable & Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Somos Group brings together legal and consulting professionals to help public- and private-sector clients solve complex challenges involving cities, development, and communities. We are a minority- and woman-owned business with deep community connections that believes the built environment is a tool for healing and promoting human potential. With offices in Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Mexico City, we work across disciplines to support community resilience, economic development, and social equity.

**About the Position**

Somos Group is seeking an organized, detail-oriented Accounts Payable/Receivable & Administrative Coordinator to join our Administration and Operations team.

This position supports day-to-day financial operations, maintains accurate records, and helps keep payments, approvals, and administrative processes moving. You will communicate regularly with clients, vendors, and colleagues while supporting the Director of Administration and Operations across bookkeeping, compliance, payroll, and benefits administration.

The ideal candidate follows through consistently, communicates clearly, and takes ownership of recurring responsibilities. You should be comfortable working with numbers, tracking outstanding items, and asking questions when something does not look right.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in our downtown Los Angeles office and requires some on-site attendance.

**What You Will Do**

**Accounts Receivable**

* Establish and maintain relationships with client billing contacts, including obtaining billing information when new engagements begin.
* Monitor outstanding balances and conduct regular, professional follow-up by phone and email.
* Maintain clear records of outreach, payments, payment commitments, and next steps.
* Participate in weekly accounts receivable meetings and coordinate follow-up priorities with firm leadership.
* Work with the Billing team to resolve invoice questions and payment discrepancies.
* Process incoming checks received in the Los Angeles office.
* Identify overdue accounts that require additional attention and escalate them per established procedures.

**Accounts Payable**

* Monitor accounts payable and bookkeeping inboxes daily.
* Monitor bank accounts daily.
* Enter bills accurately, apply appropriate accounting codes, and generate updated reports weekly.
* Verify vendor information and supporting documentation; identify duplicate or incomplete bills.
* Coordinate corrections and follow up on outstanding approvals to support timely payments.
* Process intercompany accounts payable transactions as assigned.
* Maintain organized vendor records, invoices, and payment documentation.
* Participate in weekly accounts payable meetings.

**Administrative and Bookkeeping Support**

* Complete assigned monthly bookkeeping and accounting tasks accurately and on schedule.
* Maintain firm insurance documentation and coordinate client requests for insurance certificates and riders.
* Support payroll processing, employee benefits coordination, insurance administration, and company compliance.
* Assist with tax filing and payment coordination, compliance deadlines, and audit preparation under the direction of the Director of Administration and Operations.
* Maintain accurate records and organized electronic files.
* Help maintain administrative systems, track deadlines, and follow up on open items.

**Teamwork and Backup Coverage**

Teamwork and cross-training are central to how our department operates. Everyone learns to back up other team members so essential work continues during absences and busy periods. This shared knowledge strengthens accuracy, continuity, and operational security by ensuring that critical processes do not depend on one person.

* Train to provide backup support for the Billing department, including invoice preparation, edits, approval tracking, and distribution, following established procedures.
* Provide backup coverage for designated administrative and Los Angeles office responsibilities, with appropriate training, access, and direction.
* Participate in cross-training, maintain clear process documentation, and share knowledge so teammates can provide reliable coverage for one another.
* Coordinate priorities and communicate the status of open items to support smooth handoffs and consistent service.

**What You Bring**

* Hands-on experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, bookkeeping support, or a closely related administrative role.
* Understanding of basic bookkeeping principles, invoice processing, payment tracking, and account coding.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to review your work for accuracy.
* Consistent follow-through and the ability to manage recurring deadlines and competing priorities.
* Professional written and verbal communication, including confidence following up with clients and vendors.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, and Excel.
* Ability to handle confidential financial, employee, and client information with discretion.
* Comfortable learning new systems, following established procedures, and identifying issues that need attention.
* Ability to work independently while staying responsive and connected to a team.
* Willingness to learn colleagues’ responsibilities, share your own knowledge, and provide dependable backup support.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AP/AR platforms and project management platforms. Bonus points for Deltek VantagePoint.
* Experience in a law firm, consulting firm, or other professional services environment.
* Familiarity with payroll support, benefits administration, insurance documentation, and compliance recordkeeping.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Pay: $30.00-$35.00 per hour
* Company-subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life.
* Company-matched 401(K)

Sacred Path Indigenous Wellness Center seeks a compassionate, culturally responsive Housing Outreach Coordinator to connect American Indian/Alaska Native (AI/AN) and broader Native communities with housing assistance, affordable housing, and supportive services. This position builds community partnerships, conducts outreach, supports housing navigation, and maintains program documentation to promote equitable access to resources while respecting client dignity and cultural identity.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

* Develop and implement community outreach strategies, events, workshops, and promotional materials to increase awareness of housing resources.
* Build partnerships with Native community organizations, shelters, nonprofits, government agencies, and housing providers.
* Assist clients with housing applications, eligibility requirements, referrals, and connections to supportive services; provide follow-up as appropriate.
* Refer clients to the Housing Program Outpatient Therapist when needed.
* Screen program members and enter information into Salesforce.
* Update the BHBH Resource Services Spreadsheet biweekly and monthly; maintain accurate client, outreach, and referral records.
* Track outreach activities, housing needs, and program outcomes; prepare required reports.
* Provide housing-resource education and stay informed about affordable housing, tenant rights, and homelessness prevention.
Coordinate with the Housing Program Coordinator regarding outreach priorities, service needs, and assignments across Los Angeles and Orange Counties.  

Qualifications

* 2–3 years of experience in community outreach, housing programs, or social services.
* Knowledge of housing resources, affordable housing policies, and social service systems.
* Strong communication, organization, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage competing priorities, and maintain accurate documentation.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, electronic health records, and virtual meeting tools; familiarity with Salesforce preferred.  
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in social work, public administration, urban planning, or a related field.
* **Preferred:** Experience working with American Indian/Alaska Native communities.

Core Values and Expectations

* **Cultural Respect:** Engage Native communities with cultural humility and sensitivity.
* **Compassionate Service:** Treat clients with dignity, empathy, and professionalism.
* **Equitable Access:** Help reduce barriers to housing and supportive services.
* **Community Partnership:** Build collaborative relationships that strengthen community well-being.
* **Integrity and Accountability:** Protect confidentiality, follow organizational policies, and maintain accurate, timely documentation.

Work Environment and Requirements

Work includes office-based and community outreach activities. The position requires communication, computer use, organization, multitasking, and occasional lifting up to 25 pounds.

Additional requirements:

* Eligibility to work in the United States.
* Required fingerprint clearance, annual negative TB test on file, and post-offer drug test.
* Valid California driver’s license, reliable vehicle, and active auto insurance.
* Availability for evenings and weekends as needed.
Willingness to travel within and between Los Angeles and Orange Counties; estimated travel is 30–40%.

Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator, Second Shift
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**

Supply Chain at Relativity encompasses direct supply management for all Terran-R parts and materials and materials management. Put simply, we own the value chain from identification of a need to delivery to our internal customer. The Supply Chain team's vision is to build a best-in-class, responsive, and data-driven supply chain management organization that is a key competitive advantage for Relativity. Supply Chain is currently putting that vision into practice through sourcing long-lead parts, production equipment, and infrastructure projects for Terran R production. We have had numerous accomplishments with high-dollar, impactful projects by collaborating closely with finance, manufacturing, and engineering to deliver excellent value and keep our aggressive Terran R schedule on track.

**About the Role:**

* Serve as a liaison between different organizations throughout the company to ensure components and assemblies flow smoothly through the production area while meeting timeline requirements
* Exhibit ownership for monitoring and communicating the location and status of all hardware, kits, and builds on the manufacturing floor
* Perform various ERP/MES transactions to systematically transact parts
* Demonstrated experience self-prioritizing and executing autonomously in a dynamic and sometimes ambiguous environment
* Actively seek information to understand work orders, kit requests and the needs of the internal customer
* Work with Production/Material Planning to identify part shortages

This is a second-shift position with a standard schedule of Monday through Friday, 3:00 p.m. to 1:30 a.m. PT. The role is structured around a 50-hour workweek, including 10 guaranteed overtime hours each week. In addition to base pay, employees receive a 10% shift differential.

* Able to lift up to 35lbs unassisted
* Proficient communication skills across multiple platforms (email, Slack, etc.)
* Strong computer skills; proficient with Microsoft Office
* Flexible schedule and ability to work non-standard shifts, overtime, and weekends as required

**Nice to haves but not required:**

* 5+ years of experience as a Production Coordinator or Expeditor (or similar role)
* Experience in aerospace or automotive environments
* Experience with Infor LN (ERP) and/or Jira (MES)
* Familiarity with forklift, pallet jack and other warehouse equipment

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Logistics Coordinator to join our supply chain operations team. In this role, you will be the driving force behind efficient warehouse distribution, transportation management, and inventory control. Your expertise will ensure seamless coordination across procurement, shipping, receiving, and warehouse activities, contributing to the overall success of our logistics functions. This position offers an exciting opportunity to apply your analytical skills and supply chain knowledge in a fast-paced environment committed to continuous process improvement and operational excellence.

**Duties**

* Manage end-to-end logistics processes including shipping, receiving, and inventory management systems to ensure timely and accurate order fulfillment.
* Coordinate transportation planning using transportation management systems (TMS) and collaborate with third-party logistics providers (3PL) to optimize freight costs and delivery schedules.
* Oversee warehouse distribution activities, including materials handling, stocking, and warehouse operations, ensuring compliance with safety standards.
* Utilize data analysis skills and tools such as Tableau, SQL, Excel data analysis, and spreadsheets to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), analyze supply chain data, and identify areas for process improvement.
* Conduct root cause analysis on supply chain disruptions or inefficiencies to develop effective solutions that enhance overall process flow.
* Engage in category management and sourcing activities by negotiating with vendors, managing procurement processes, and maintaining supplier relationships for optimal pricing and service levels.
* Support international trade compliance by understanding trade regulations and ensuring adherence during import/export activities.
* Practice cross-functional communication with procurement, production planning, customer service, and warehouse teams to align supply chain strategies with business goals.
* Prepare, review, and maintain all shipping and receiving documents (BOLs, packing lists, invoices, PODs, etc.).

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in supply chain operations or logistics roles with a focus on warehouse management systems (WMS), inventory control, or transportation planning.
* Strong data collection and analysis skills using tools such as Excel (including data analysis), SQL, Tableau, or other analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with ERP systems like AS400 or similar enterprise resource planning software.
* Knowledge of freight management including NVOCC (Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier), shipping & receiving procedures, and trade compliance standards.
* Experience with procurement processes such as sourcing, vendor management, pricing negotiations, and category management.
* Ability to operate warehouse equipment such as forklifts safely; forklift certification is preferred.
* Excellent organizational skills combined with the ability to manage multiple priorities efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication skills for effective collaboration across departments and external partners.

Join us in transforming supply chain operations through innovative solutions and strategic thinking! We value energetic professionals eager to make an impact in logistics management while supporting our mission of delivering exceptional service worldwide.

Pay: $27.75 per hour

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable with the salary being offered for this position?

Language:

* Korean (Preferred)
* Spanish (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

Modena Health ("MH") and Modena Allergy & Asthma ("MAA") are leading and rapidly growing medical practices specializing in allergy, asthma, and immunology care, with clinics across Southern California and Arizona—and ambitious plans for national expansion. We are physician-led, hospitality-focused, and technology-enabled, committed to transforming allergy care while advancing clinical research and expanding access to cutting-edge medicine.

Known for our high standard of excellence, we provide compassionate, patient-centered care for both pediatric and adult patients. Our model combines hospitality-driven service with innovative technology solutions that streamline operations, improve clinical outcomes, and enhance the experience for both patients and providers.

At Modena, we aim to hire great people, treat them well, and help them find meaning and purpose in our mission. Our dedicated team values collaboration, positivity, and growth while striving to improve lives through expert diagnosis, treatment, and research. We are looking for high-energy, kind, and collaborative individuals eager to grow personally and professionally while making a meaningful impact in the lives of others.

You'll help manage and grow Modena's digital presence across social platforms, create engaging content, support clinic launches and events, and help position Modena as a leading voice in the healthcare space, with a focus on the food allergy space.

You should be equal parts creative and execution-oriented, comfortable developing content ideas one minute and coordinating a shoot or schedule of posts the next.

* Support new clinic launches, community events, and partnerships
* Collaborate with physicians and leadership to turn medical topics into patient-friendly content
* Monitor social media trends, platform updates, and opportunities for growth
* Assist with influencer/community outreach and local partnerships
* Track engagement metrics and help optimize content performance
* Maintain brand consistency across all digital touchpoints
* Help create and update marketing materials like flyers, banners and program materials

**What We're Looking For**

* 1-2 years of experience in social media, content marketing, digital marketing, or a related role
* Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and short-form video trends
* Excellent writing and communication skills
* Comfortable filming and editing content on iPhone and/or professional cameras
* Experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar editing tools
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* Self-starter mentality with the ability to move quickly and manage multiple projects
* Creative eye for branding, aesthetics, and storytelling

-------------------

IGN Entertainment is looking for a Sales Coordinator to join our Consumer Sales team. You will be the central support hub for our team, keeping campaigns, renewals, and client relationships running smoothly from start to finish.

This is a unique opportunity to learn the digital advertising business from the ground up. This work is fast-paced, creative, and self-guided, with new problems to solve every day. If you have a passion for pop culture, a knack for organization, and the drive to take initiative, this is the perfect chance to build foundational skills and help shape how the world's largest brands, including Coca-Cola, Lego, Butterfinger, and Microsoft, engage with the future of pop culture.

* This is a hybrid role with an expectation to work in out offices 3 days per week. We are looking for candidates based in Los Angeles or New York City.
* This role is full-time, with an expectation to occasionally require work during evenings or weekends for client services, campaign reporting, and client entertainment/events. All candidates must be willing and able to work standard hours in the Eastern Time Zone.
* Some travel is required for this position to industry events and client meetings.
* This role involves standard office tasks, such as sitting at a computer. Additionally, travel and participation in industry events may require prolonged periods of standing and walking.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Act as the central support hub and point of contact for our Sales Managers and Account Executives, ensuring they have what they need to succeed every day. This includes keeping proposals, wrap reports, and ad tags organized.
* Manage sales workstreams and campaigns from the start, tracking timelines and deliverables across multiple accounts at once.
* Take notes on internal and client calls, send clear recaps, and follow up on action items to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Partner with AEs to keep renewal timelines on track, pull performance data, and prepare materials that set up the next deal.
* Work with our Ad Ops team to check inventory availability across IGN's sites for client proposals and campaigns.
* Help execute campaigns by managing ad trafficking, performing quality assurance with Rev Ops on custom creative, and monitoring pacing. Build and send campaign reports directly to clients to ensure their expectations are met.
* Get up to speed on IGN's full suite of advertising products, including display media, branded content, video shows, social, and programmatic. You'll use this knowledge to help develop sales materials.
* Manage our reservation system and keep detailed records of business in Salesforce and other internal tools. Your attention to detail keeps our cross-functional teams (Ad Ops, Revenue Operations, Finance, Creative Strategy, Client Services, and Design) aligned and informed.
* Help respond to RFPs by pulling research, securing ad inventory, and building visually appealing presentation materials.

**Job Qualifications**
----------------------

##### **The Must-Haves**

* You are highly organized and skilled at multitasking, with strong time management. You can prioritize competing tasks in a fast-paced environment with ease.
* You have strong written and verbal communication skills with both internal teams and external clients, and a keen eye for detail.
* You're a self-starter. You take initiative without being told what to do, figure out who to go to when you don't know the answer, and are comfortable tackling things you haven't done before.
* You're a natural problem solver who enjoys collaboration, and you'll learn to write clear, concise, and professional emails.
* You're coachable and curious. You ask good questions, welcome feedback, and bring a positive, team-first attitude to the work.
* You take thorough notes and follow up consistently.
* You're comfortable in Excel (sorting, filtering, and basic formulas) and PowerPoint (building clean, on-brand slides), and proficient in Google Workspace. You can quickly pick up new software and systems.

##### **Bonus Points**

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). jobs.description:
**Position:** Inside Sales Representative

**Employment Type:** Regular Full-Time, Non-Exempt

**Schedule:** Monday-Friday, 9 a.m. - 5:30 p.m.

**Department:** Marketing & Communications

**Salary Range:**  $22.00/hour, plus tiered, uncapped commission

**Reports to:** Director of Marketing Analytics & Patron Insights

**About the Role:**

Pacific Symphony is seeking a driven, high-energy Inside Sales Representative to introduce and reintroduce audiences to the world of classical music while generating new institutional revenue. The representative will serve as a primary point of contact for prospective and returning patrons, proactively converting qualified leads into first-time buyers, repeat buyers, Symphony Pass members, and subscribers.

The representative will manage assigned prospects throughout the sales lifecycle, from initial outreach and conversion through follow-up, reengagement, and ongoing cultivation. By developing patron relationships and recommending relevant concerts and ticket products, the representative will help increase repeat attendance, customer lifetime value, and long-term engagement with Pacific Symphony.

This fast-paced, results-oriented role is ideal for individuals who thrive on high-volume outbound outreach, use conversational storytelling to build trust, and love the challenge of closing sales while representing one of Southern California's leading cultural institutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Lead Conversion:** Conduct high-volume outreach to qualified prospects, converting cold and warm leads into first-time ticket buyers, repeat buyers, Symphony Pass members, and package subscribers.
* **Sales Lifecycle Management:** Manage assigned prospects from initial outreach through conversion, post-purchase follow-up, reengagement, cross-selling, and upgrading. Cultivate buyers toward repeat attendance, multi-ticket purchases, Symphony Pass, and subscription products.
* **Patron Engagement:** Serve as a brand ambassador for Pacific Symphony, using consultative and conversational selling to understand patron interests, recommend relevant concert experiences, address questions, and communicate the value of classical music.
* **Revenue Generation**: Meet and exceed individual sales and revenue targets while developing sustainable pipelines of new and returning patrons.
* **Patron Development:** Build relationships that increase customer lifetime value and encourage deeper engagement with Pacific Symphony. Identify potential philanthropic interest and refer qualified donor opportunities to the Development team for appropriate follow-up.
* **CRM Management:** Maintain accurate and timely records of lead assignments, patron interactions, follow-up activities, opportunity stages, purchases, sales attribution, and pipeline status in the organization’s CRM systems.

**Key Skills & Qualifications:**

· **Experience**: One year experience in inside sales, telemarketing, lead generation, or high-volume call-center environments.

· **Communication**: Exceptional verbal communication, active listening, and rapport-building skills, with a natural ability to use consultative, conversational selling to engage prospects.

· **Resilience**: Goal-oriented, persistent, and able to navigate customer rejection or challenging outbound conversations.

· **Technical Literacy**: Comfortable using standard computer software, CRM platforms, and sales databases.

· **Self-Starter and Team Collaboration**: Highly motivated to meet individual sales goals with minimal supervision while contributing to a collaborative, supportive team environment.

· **Bonus Qualifications**: Familiarity with or enthusiasm for the performing arts, live events, symphonic music, or nonprofit cultural programming.

**Position Focus & Commission Eligibility Rules**

· **Target Audience:** Develop new and returning audiences, with a strategic focus on cultivating patrons with the potential to become repeat buyers, multi-ticket buyers, Symphony Pass members, and subscribers. The role will work from assigned lead lists and campaigns and will not compete with Box Office or existing Telemarketing responsibilities.

· **Eligible Sales:** Commission is earned on eligible single-ticket, Symphony Pass, subscription, reactivation, upgrade, and add-on purchases generated through assigned outreach and properly attributed to the representative.

· **Handoff Policy:** Clear operational workflows are in place for cross-departmental leads. Inbound group sales inquiries, donor upgrades, or structural memberships are handed off to specialized internal departments and do not qualify for base commission.

**Compensation:**

· **Base Compensation + Uncapped Commission:** Receive steady base compensation plus tiered, uncapped commission on eligible and properly attributed net ticket revenue.

· **Tiered Commission Structure:** Commission rates increase as the representative reaches defined annual sales milestones, rewarding new-patron acquisition, returning-patron conversion, and above-target performance.

· **Paid Professional Training:** Thorough, paid onboarding covering Pacific Symphony programming, conversational sales scripting, and database training.

· **Full-Time Benefits Package:** Eligible for Pacific Symphony’s comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid holidays, and vacation time.

**Why Join Us:** This is a unique opportunity to build a high-performance sales career while connecting entirely new audiences to world-class live music. As part of our team, you will:

· Gain hands-on experience in inside sales, pipeline management, and live event revenue generation.

· Work within a mission-driven organization that leaves a lasting cultural impact on the Southern California community.

· Learn the inner workings of arts administration alongside a premier cultural institution.

**Project Coordinator III**

itD is seeking a **Project Coordinator III** to support budget planning, forecasting, spend governance, accruals, and reporting within a leading technology company's Hardware Devices organization. The ideal candidate will bring 5+ years of experience in financial operations, spend analysis, budgeting, and forecasting, with practical expertise in AI-driven workflow automation and a proven track record of delivering actionable financial insights to directors and senior leadership.

**Location:** Hybrid — Sunnyvale, CA (3 days per week onsite).

**Duration:** 12 months

**Pay Rate:** $60 - $65 per hour.

We provide comprehensive medical benefits, a 401(k) plan, paid holidays, and more.

Please note that we are only considering direct W2 candidates at this time, as we are unable to offer sponsorship.

**Responsibilities**

* Support quarterly and annual budget planning and forecasting cycles by guiding engineering teams through processes, resolving inquiries, and ensuring timely submissions.
* Analyze budget, forecast, and actual spend data to identify variances, explain underlying drivers, and recommend opportunities to optimize spending.
* Audit budget and forecast submissions to ensure financial data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across engineering teams.
* Manage monthly accrual cycles by collecting and validating accruals against open purchase order balances and goods or services received, ensuring timely and accurate submissions.
* Develop and maintain recurring reports and dashboards covering budget status, forecasts, commitments, vendors, purchase orders, and financial performance for leadership.
* Build and implement reusable AI agents, prompt-based assistants, and workflow automation solutions to streamline recurring financial analysis, reporting, and business processes.
* Partner with budget owners, engineering teams, Procurement, Sourcing Managers, Accounts Payable, and program management to resolve spend-related questions, present insights to directors and senior leaders, track action items, and drive issues to closure.

**Internal Responsibilities**

* Attend regular internal practice community meetings.
* Collaborate with your itD practice team on industry thought leadership.
* Complete client case studies and learning material, including blogs and media material.
* Build out material to contribute to the Digital Transformation practice.
* Attend internal itD networking events, both in person and virtually.
* Work with leadership on career fast-track opportunities.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in spend tracking, budgeting, forecasting, and capacity or resource analysis.
* Practical experience with prompt engineering, AI agent development, or workflow automation to improve business processes.
* Advanced spreadsheet skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and large-workbook modeling.
* Experience analyzing financial data, identifying spend and forecast variances, and developing actionable recommendations.
* Experience building dashboards and data visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or equivalent BI tools.
* Demonstrated ability to create and present financial reports and insights to directors and senior leadership, including non-finance stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain financial findings clearly and concisely.
* Ability to work autonomously in ambiguous environments, manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and proactively follow up on outstanding actions.
* Ability to handle confidential budget, vendor, and headcount information with discretion.

**Preferred Qualifications and Skills**

* Experience supporting engineering, hardware, R&D, manufacturing, or consumer electronics organizations.
* Experience with New Product Introduction (NPI) processes and product development lifecycle milestones.
* Previous experience at major technology or product companies such as Apple, Google, or Microsoft.
* Experience implementing process improvements, change management initiatives, and new business workflows.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
* Relevant professional experience or certifications in data analytics, Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, SQL, or cloud-based data analytics.

**Education**

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field is preferred but not required. Equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.

**Company Description**  
About itD: We are part of a new generation of consulting and software development company that blends diversity, innovation, and integrity with real business results. Our structure rejects any strong hierarchy, empowering us to deliver excellent results. We are a woman- and minority-led firm. Every day, we challenge ourselves to be considerate, fair and to re-think what great outcomes mean for our customers. This permeates down to how we approach every interaction, on every project, for every client. You'll thrive here if you are a dynamic self-starter, a difference-maker or someone who wants to deliver great results, without constraints.

The itD Digital Experience: Joining us means you'll be part of our global community, you have a say about your own career journey, and you'll get a chance to give back to causes that matter. You will experience working with Fortune 500 companies and high-performance teams across numerous industries. itD offers our employees excellent benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life insurance, paid holidays, 401K + matching, networking & career learning and development programs. We are growing and we want to see you grow! Visit https://itdtech.com/careers to learn more about what working at itD can mean for you.

jobs.title: Day Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**In-Custody Day Program Coordinator**

The Gemma Project is seeking skilled, passionate, and dedicated individuals eager to contribute to our mission of providingand promoting the national creation of gender-responsive jail reentry programming for incarcerated and formerly incarcerated women. The Gemma Project is a trauma responsive, female-led organization that centers integrity and compassion in all the services we provide. Join our team to help us to reduce recidivism, break the intergenerational cycle of incarceration, and create healthier communities.

​​Individuals with a history of justice system involvement are strongly encouraged to apply*.*

**Physical Requirements:**

This position requires approximately 50% of work hours within in-custody jail settings and access to sensitive and protected data and therefore requires but is not limited to completion of Live Scan fingerprinting, and Tuberculosis testing prior to hire and ability *to* abide by all in-custody rules as it relates to attire, personal belongings, materials, conduct, and use of sensitive data.

**How you'll fit in:**

You’ll be a great fit for our team if you are highly skilled, compassionate, and dedicated to providing direct-service reentry programming in an in-custody setting to justice involved women. The Day Program Coordinator works to build rapport and trusting relationships with participants in a group setting prior to release and collaborates with the Continuing Care Coordinator through intentional efforts to maintain participant engagement upon release. The Day Program Coordinator conducts all aspects of running in-custody programming including: interviews, assessments, acceptance decisions; develops, delivers and maintains a relevant, applicable and trauma-responsive curriculum; provides consistent course supervision, safety, and structure to support participants in successful program completion, demonstrates healthy professional boundaries; recruits, trains, and supervises volunteer instructors and works with them to improve and update curricula as needed; works in close collaboration with The Gemma Project Team; supervises and provides direction to the Day Program Assistant; conducts necessary outreach for program; assists in evaluation of program effectiveness; maintains program data and contributes to necessary reports; engages professionally with corrections and community partners as well as funders, donors, and model site visitors.

This position reports to the Executive Director.

**What you'll do:**

* Provide overall operations of Gemma Day Program
* Maintain and update the program curriculum and schedule
* Facilitate core components of curriculum
* Recruit, train and maintain skilled volunteer program instructors
* Support, train, and guide volunteer instructors throughout sessions
* Evaluate instructor performance and make programmatic changes when necessary
* Interview, assess and make admission decisions for all applicants
* Evaluate participant progress and provide feedback to participants as needed
* Provide support and redirection to participants as needed in and out of sessions
* Respond to and document program and participant issues in a clear and timely manner
* Supervise Day Program Assistant(s)
* Coordinate with Continuing Care Coordinator on curriculum and reentry planning to assure seamless support for participants transitioning out of custody
* Collect data to assess program effectiveness and work with Executive Director to make necessary changes based on data
* Maintain accurate and timely records and prepare and submit reports as needed
* Plan and facilitate graduation ceremonies
* Perform outreach/recruitment to encourage program participation
* Perform administrative and clerical duties necessary to the position
* Maintain facility, equipment, and materials
* Attend and actively contribute to team meetings and other organizational meetings
* Attend meetings relevant to community partnerships as needed
* Work in close collaboration with Corrections staff to maintain safety, structure and integrity of program
* Regularly communicate and coordinate with Executive Director and report any concerns
* Support related fund development activities
* Provide health and Medi-Cal outreach, information, referral, eligibility, access assistance, planning and MAA coordination activities
* Perform outreach activities related to Program as needed
* Other duties as assigned

**What you'll bring:**

* Passion for The Gemma Project’s mission and empathy for the unique challenges facing incarcerated and formerly incarcerated women
* Commitment to positively contributing to a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and trauma responsive organizational culture through self-awareness, cultural humility, and valuing others
* Dedication to supporting and celebrating female identified individuals in their healing, development, and contributions to the community
* A reputation for a high standard of honesty, integrity, and professionalism
* A curious, detail-oriented, and problem-solving mindset focused on centering gender and trauma responsive services
* The ability to create and maintain collaborative relationships across other functional areas to solve problems, and improve programs, systems, and outcomes for participants
* Receptivity to feedback and ability to ask for and accept help
* The ability to find joy in our work, contribute to optimism, and celebrate individual and team achievements
* Exceptional skill at creating and maintaining a safe, structured, supportive, and trauma-responsive learning environment for participants
* Strong group facilitation and management skills including the ability to maximize participation and engage individuals with different learning styles and abilities
* Strong oral communication skills, including the ability to diffuse and deescalate challenging situations, distill and present complex information in a concise, accessible way, and capability of delivering difficult info

jobs.description:
**Job title:** Client Services Coordinator

**Location:** San Francisco, CA; 5 days in office/week

**Status:** Full time; non-exempt (40 hours/week FT NE)

**Salary:** $62,000 - $67,000/year

**Reports to:** Program Director

**Organization Description**

The Miss Major Alexander L. Lee TGIJP Black Trans Cultural Center is a team of transgender, gender-variant and intersex people, inside and outside of prisons, jails, detention centers, and other locked facilities creating a united family in the struggle for survival and freedom. We work in collaboration with others to forge a culture of resistance and resilience to strengthen us for the fight against human rights abuses, imprisonment, police violence, racism, poverty, and societal pressures. We seek to create a world rooted in self-determination, freedom of expression, and gender justice.

**Position Description**

TGIJP’s Client Services Coordinators are the first to greet our clients, staff, partners, Board Members, and other community members when they come into our office. First impressions are everything when it comes to telegraphing safety, security, empowerment, trauma-informed care, and an abolitionist mindset to all we meet. You’re expected to know how to work with dozens of different kinds of people effectively, to know how to appropriately prioritize and execute administrative and operational tasks, and to be able to maintain a level of professionalism, pleasant demeanor, and grounded approach to the work.

**Primary Responsibilities**

***1. Client and Staff Support***

* Greet clients and others who come into the office in a friendly and helpful manner; determine reason for visit, log visitors in and out.
* Provide information and referrals to clients and others as appropriate.
* Notify staff of clients or other’s presence; facilitate communication between clients and staff.
* Accompany clients into Etta’s Closet on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and assist in keeping the closet organized, stocked, and neat.
* Help the legal and reentry departments by replying to mail we receive from currently incarcerated clients.
* Support case managers with organizing and sorting their client files.
* Staff the front desk during Niomi Jenkins Community Care Freedom School and Blue Sky Reentry Mail Nights as needed.
* Inform direct supervisor/s when we’re running low on office and/or cleaning supplies, client snacks, and other important materials.
* Assist with welcoming new staff and acclimating them to the office culture.
* Post TGIJP and partner event flyers around the office as directed.

***2. Safety Support***

* Monitor clients entering and exiting the space for weapons, and maintain bike tracking and storage.
* Supervise clients, staff, and the general public who may be waiting in lobby or front desk areas.
* Maintain safety protocol, and serve on the TGIJP Safety Committee.

***3. Administrative Support***

* Organize and manage the front desk, documents, and relevant paperwork while removing any clutter.
* Answer front desk phone calls while maintaining HIPAA compliance.
* Answer and forward general inquiries sent to the inbox.
* Print and update the client and staff front desk sign-in sheets.
* Distribute client mail to clients and Housing Case Managers.
* Promote upcoming TGIJP events and client satisfaction surveys.
* Attend training and meetings as scheduled and assigned.
* Submit monthly progress reports to the Program Director.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Onos Health**

Onos Health’s mission is simple but ambitious: ensure every healthcare dollar goes toward delivering the highest quality care. Today, nearly 30% of U.S. healthcare spending is wasted due to ineffective care and administrative burden caused by misalignment between providers and payers.

Onos is addressing this by building the AI platform that enables health plans to understand clinical care at scale. By transforming unstructured clinical documentation into actionable insights, we help payers make faster, more informed decisions, identify opportunities to improve quality and reduce waste, and ensure more healthcare dollars are directed toward delivering better outcomes.

Come join a category-defining company and transform how healthcare is managed in the U.S.

**Why Onos**

Meaningful impact: Help solve one of healthcare’s biggest challenges by improving quality while reducing waste.

Ownership: Take on significant responsibility from day one and shape a rapidly growing company.

Direct collaboration: Work alongside experienced founders with deep expertise in healthcare, AI, and product development.

High-performing team: Join a transparent, collaborative, and execution-focused culture.

Build something new: Help define the next generation of AI-powered healthcare analytics.

**The Role**

Onos is growing, and our health plan customers are growing with us. As a Strategic Account Manager, you’ll be the go to person payers count on to make Onos work for them, and the person our product and operations teams count on to tell them what those payers actually need.

In this role you’ll manage real payer relationships, shape how we deliver value, and help set up the processes that let us scale without losing the personal touch.

**What you’ll own**

* Strategic payer relationships: you’re the day-to-day lead and trusted advisor for a portfolio of health plan customers
* Cross-functional partnership: you work with product and operations to make sure payers get the most out of Onos
* Voice of the customer: you bring client needs, feedback, and friction points back to the team, and push to get them addressed
* Account initiatives and project execution: you drive them from kickoff to delivery, on time and with clear owners
* Scaling the account function: you help build the processes, playbooks, and operating rhythms that support our growth across Onos
* Other duties as needed. We’re an early team, so the work will evolve.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in strategic account management, product management, or client services
* Bonus if you have 1–2 years of management consulting experience
* Direct experience with healthcare payers, whether working at a health plan or managing health plan clients as a vendor or partner
* Working knowledge of how healthcare businesses and payers operate, including the stakeholders and priorities
* Familiarity with payer data, health plan workflows, or value-based care programs
* Experience with AI-enabled products or technical SaaS platforms
* Startup or fast-paced environment experience where things aren’t defined. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, and you bring structure to it instead of waiting for it to clear up
* A proactive, forward-thinking approach to client management. You anticipate what clients will need before they ask, bring clarity when the path isn’t obvious, and act without waiting for direction
* Track record of working cross-functionally with product teams while driving projects and initiatives across the organization
* Comfort translating between client needs and internal teams, in both directions
* Experience building account management processes, playbooks, or reporting from scratch
* Strong written and verbal communication, including with senior client stakeholders

**Benefits & Perks**

* Hybrid 3x per week in office (Mon/Tues/Thurs) in San Francisco, Financial District
* Flexible vacation policy
* Paid parental leave
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* 401(k)
* Significant equity as an early employee
* Direct mentorship from experienced founders
* Ground-floor opportunity to help build both the product and company
* Regular team events and off-sites
* Company provided equipment and home office setup
* In-office lunches and snacks provided

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Onos. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic.

Compensation Range: $150K - $180K

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS is seeking an experienced Strategic Account Manager to lead and continue to expand the business with one of our company’s largest and most innovative customers.  
  
The Strategic Account Manager will be a key member of the team responsible for providing business leadership and creative direction for this highly visible customer. You will build and maintain broad relationships in the account, develop and manage opportunities, and lead a large team of extended resources. You will define the executive relationship strategy within the account; including building a strong working relationship with the AWS senior leadership team for executive sponsorship, executive business reviews, and shaping go-to-market opportunities.  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the 8 description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities  
Increase technology adoption and creating long term transformational account strategies  
Build strategic relationships within the account and articulate a clear vision with impact across all business groups  
Identifying, developing, negotiating, and closing large-scale technology projects to global business units  
Work will all appropriate AWS resources (Executives, Solutions Architects, Business Development, Partners, and Professional Services)  
  
About the team  
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their cloud journey and work backwards from their industry specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our industry customers, which means that we focus on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

jobs.description:
**ABOUT PALO ALTO FIT**

Palo Alto Fit, doing business as Palo Alto Fitness Club, is Palo Alto's premier private personal training facility, home to a team of 30+ professional coaches dedicated to delivering exceptional, individualized training, a team that will grow to 50 in the next 12 to 18 months. Our 8,000 square foot appointment-only facility on California Avenue is designed exclusively for high-quality one-on-one coaching, and we are expanding to approximately 12,000 square feet in 2026/27, every square foot of it dedicated to personal training.

Our clients are professionals, families, and individuals from Palo Alto, Stanford, and the surrounding Peninsula who value expertise, privacy, and a highly personalized training experience. They are discerning and accustomed to excellence, and they expect the same from us. We are not a traditional gym. We are a professional training facility built on relationships, consistency, and long-term client success.

For more than 10 years, Palo Alto Fit has served individuals and families in Palo Alto and built a reputation for professionalism, a well-run studio, and exceptional client care, with more than 200 five-star Google reviews to show for it.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is one of the most critical roles in the studio, and it is a hands-on role. The Fitness Coordinator owns every new client's first ninety days with us, and the relationship after that. You conduct our Fitness Assessment yourself: you see how a person moves, you understand their injuries, limitations and goals, and you write the handover that lets our coaching team build the right program from day one. You match them to the right coach, carry them through their first weeks until training is a habit, check in along the way, and work with the coach so the assessment and the program stay one plan. You sell the first package, you make every renewal happen, and you keep every client training. The first-renewal rate and the renewal rate are the measures of your work.

You are not coaching sessions, and you are not waiting for the phone to ring. You are on the floor: assessing a prospective client at ten, closing a renewal at eleven, briefing a coach in between, calling a client who went quiet, and making sure a thirty-coach calendar, soon fifty, is exactly right. The instinct to solve a problem the moment it appears, rather than pass it on, is the whole job.

And you will work with everyone. In one day you may assess a twelve-year-old athlete with a parent beside them, a founder between meetings, a physician from Stanford, a retired engineer coming back from surgery, and a family of four who train together. Each one needs a different conversation and the same standard of care.

The problems are real and they are yours: the client who paid and never started, the standing slot that quietly ran out, the client at five sessions left whose coach has not yet talked to them about renewing, the family sharing one package who want to know exactly how many sessions are left. Each one is solved by someone who reads the situation, picks up the phone, and sees it through.

The bar here is deliberately high. Everyone on this team earned their place, and that is exactly why they are proud to be here.

**SELL: TURN A PROSPECT INTO A NEW CLIENT**

Be the first point of contact for prospective clients by phone, email, and in person, and the person who runs their first visit.

Conduct the **Fitness Assessment**, our 45-minute in-person consultation and intake: health and training history, a movement screen, a baseline body-composition scan, and the goal conversation. This is a consultation, not a training session, and you run it yourself.

**See and understand the client's limitations.** An old knee, a back that sits all day, a shoulder that will not go overhead, a nervous first-timer: you recognize what the body in front of you can and cannot do yet, and you ask the questions that surface what they did not think to mention.

**Explain in plain words what the assessment showed and how we will get them started:** here is why the knee complains, here are the muscles that need to get stronger first, here are the exercises we begin with.

**Guide each new client to the package and membership that fit their goals, and complete enrollment.** A consultative conversation, never a hard sell. The first package is your close.

Match each new client to the right coach, lock their standing weekly slot, and book their first session before they leave.

**Document the handover:** goals, history, limitations, what to protect, what the client wants to feel. A coach who reads your notes trains the client safely from minute one without the client repeating a word.

**KEEP: THE FIRST NINETY DAYS, AND THE RELATIONSHIP AFTER**

Send the welcome and check-in emails on their day, and call any client who has not started or has gone quiet.

Work our client dashboard every shift: who needs a next session, who is slipping, whose rescan is due, whose standing slot has run out, and act on it the same day.

**Be the link between the assessment and the program:** brief the coach before the first session, agree the next step when something changes, and make sure what you saw in the assessment is what the client is training on.

Check in with the client at the set points of their first weeks, and bring what you hear back to the coach.

Keep every client's record current, so a colleague or coach can pick up the relationship from the profile alone.

Reach back out to quiet clients and past prospects with genuine, low-pressure care.

**RENEW: TURN A NEW CLIENT INTO ONE WHO TRAINS WITH US FOR YEARS**

Track every client's remaining sessions and see each renewal coming at five sessions left.

Make sure the coach opens the renewal conversation, remind at three sessions left, and close and process the purchase so nobody's training lapses.

**About Watershed**
-------------------

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

**The role**

We’re looking for ambitious sales development hires to bring Watershed to more companies. We’re at an inflection point: every large company is launching a climate program as pressure for action builds every day. You’ll do whatever it takes to get those companies engaged on climate and excited about working with Watershed. As an early member of our go-to-market organization, you’ll help build the sales playbook, shape Watershed’s product, help us build a stellar team, and accelerate pipeline across North America.

This hire must be in our HQ in San Francisco.

**You will:**

**About TLC Nurse Solutions**

TLC Nurse Solutions is a women-owned California nurse registry thoughtfully coordinating experienced independent Registered Nurses (RNs) and Licensed Vocational Nurses (LVNs) with private-pay clients and healthcare partners throughout California.

Our Care Coordination & Office Operations Team is at the heart of that work. We coordinate referrals, schedules, communication, documentation, credentialing, and billing support while helping clients, nurses, and healthcare partners feel informed and well supported.

**About the Position**

This is a hands-on role within a collaborative, growing small business. Priorities can shift throughout the day as new referrals arrive, schedules change, or a client or nurse needs timely assistance. The right person enjoys bringing calm and organization to a responsive environment, takes genuine ownership of their work, and follows important details through to completion.

Every team member is cross-trained in TLC's core operations so we can support one another, provide dependable coverage, and continue improving how we work.

**What You Will Do**

· Coordinate new and ongoing nursing referrals, schedules, and coverage needs.

· Communicate professionally and compassionately with clients, families, independent nurses, specialty pharmacies, physicians, healthcare facilities, case managers, discharge planners, and other referral partners.

· Respond to phone calls, emails, text messages, and faxes in a timely and organized manner.

· Manage schedule changes, cancellations, urgent coverage requests, and other time-sensitive needs.

· Review nursing documentation for completeness and process it promptly.

· Assist with client invoicing, contractor invoice processing, and related follow-up.

· Maintain accurate scheduling, credentialing, compliance, and operational records.

· Follow written Standard Operating Procedures while helping identify practical workflow improvements.

· Support teammates and participate in shared evening, weekend, and holiday on-call coverage.

People who thrive at TLC care about doing things well, helping others, and contributing to the organization as a whole. They tend to:

· Take ownership, show initiative, and follow responsibilities through to completion.

· Stay organized, responsive, and attentive to details while managing multiple priorities.

· Enjoy figuring things out, connecting the pieces, and learning how different parts of the work fit together.

· Communicate clearly, warmly, kindly, and proactively with clients, nurses, healthcare partners, and teammates.

· Remain calm, thoughtful, and solution-focused when circumstances change or something unexpected comes up.

· Use sound judgment, make confident routine decisions, and ask thoughtful questions when collaboration is helpful.

· Notice what needs attention and help move it forward rather than waiting for every next step to be assigned.

· Take pride in becoming knowledgeable, capable, and dependable in their work.

· Bring a positive, helpful attitude and genuinely enjoy contributing to a collaborative team.

· Strong organizational, written communication, and verbal communication skills.

· Comfort managing multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.

· Ability to work independently and contribute to a close, collaborative team.

**Qualifications**

jobs.description:
**About the Company**

The Armenian General Benevolent Union was established in 1906 and is the world’s largest non-profit organization devoted to preserving and promoting the Armenian identity and heritage through educational, cultural, and humanitarian programs. AGBU currently has a presence in over 40 countries, annually touching the lives of some 500,000 Armenians worldwide.

**About Camp Nubar**

Founded in 1963, Camp Nubar is a six-week sleep-away summer camp located on its 365-acre home in the Catskill Mountains region of New York State. Each summer over 300 campers from all over the world (Canada, Europe, Eurasia, all across America) call Camp Nubar their home away from home. Camp Nubar has state-of-the-art facilities, a varied program, and is proud to offer a rich cultural experience in an environment that rivals the best privately owned summer camps in America. The goals of Camp Nubar are determined by a Committee of approximately 12 volunteer members, all alumni of the camp themselves.

**Job Description**

The Program Coordinator reports to the Director of Diaspora Youth Programs and works closely with the Camp Nubar Committee Chair, Camp Director, and Camp Nubar Committee. The position is based out of AGBU’s global headquarters in New York City and may require occasional weekend and evening hours.

* Coordinate year-round camper recruitment and enrollment efforts in collaboration with AGBU Communications, the Camp Nubar Committee, alumni networks, Armenian churches, schools, chapters, and community partners

* Assist with seasonal staff contracts, documentation, and other onboarding requirements in coordination with the Camp Director, Camp Committee, and relevant AGBU departments

Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years.

This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.

This is Kaizen's first dedicated events hire, and it's a build role. Our events have been run part time alongside other responsibilities. You'll set the strategy, own the calendar and the budget, and be accountable for what the program produces.

* You're emotionally intelligent, thoughtful, and empathetic toward public sector missions

------------------
